title: 六网建设像修路建港：先发订单再托底消费，AI高科技接棒地产
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: And what form could that take? Is it manufacturing, is it services, could it boost productivity even? I certainly think that would be the case because first of all, there would be orders coming out.
segments.zh: 会以什么形式呈现？是制造业、服务业，还是提升生产率？我确实认为会是这样，因为首先会有订单释放。

segments.en: And therefore, especially those in manufacturing sector, from upstream to all the way to downstream would probably benefit from that. You see equipment purchase, you see laborers also being employed, generating income.
segments.zh: 因此，尤其是制造业从上游到下游都可能受益，设备采购增加，劳动力就业和收入也随之改善。

segments.en: So not only that this investment is going to create a support for industrial production, but at the same time, I think they generate enough jobs to also prop up consumption, which is very much needed as well.
segments.zh: 这不仅为工业生产提供支撑，同时也能创造足够就业，进而托底消费，而消费正是当前非常需要的。

segments.en: So we think that this is going to potentially support the development going forward of the technology sector. So think about the fact that in the past we need airport railway and also highways to get the low value added manufacturing going.
segments.zh: 我们认为这可能支持科技领域未来发展。想想过去，我们需要机场、铁路和高速公路来推动低附加值制造业。

segments.en: Now we need the six networks to get basically the AI related high tech sectors going. So that's kind of the very basic. For example, if you travel nowadays, you will see that sometimes the yes AI models are very fast.
segments.zh: 现在我们需要六网建设来推动AI相关高科技领域，这是非常基础的。比如现在出行时，有时AI模型运行很快。

segments.en: For example, recently I was traveling in the US and found yes AI models there were working great, but actually the reception is quite poor. So when communication networks don't necessarily play catch-up, you could potentially see that even the fastest and most advanced models could be set back because of that.
segments.zh: 比如最近我在美国出行，发现AI模型运行很好，但信号接收很差。如果通信网络跟不上，即使最快最先进的模型也可能因此受限。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, if you can't get into the restaurant, you can't order the Michelin star dish. It's a straight analogy. Well, does this take the place of old school stimulus then?
segments.zh: 是的，如果进不了餐厅，就点不了米其林星级菜，这个类比很直接。那么这会取代传统刺激方式吗？
